summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve the E-Rate program to maintain essential connectivity and infrastructure costs for schools. The school district urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding and support, emphasizing the ongoing cost of connectivity and the program's role in providing reliable educational infrastructure.

claims.requested_action: reject proposal to sunset or eliminate E-Rate program
claims.argument: E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 provides recurring cost for connectivity
claims.evidence_quote:
E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 
— an average of roughly $26,300 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does 
not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
